description: §8.3 `.get()` single-row hydrate (RUNTIME, serverDb) — the first row of the seeded table reaches the client. The legacy `<current> = not` cell (a `User | not`, which the §66 opener cannot type yet) is two typed cells here; the asserted values are the case's ({id: 1, name: "Alice"}).
rationale: The bootstrap-gradable twin of server-db/sql-get-single-row-rt: that case is in the legacy declaration form (`<x> = []` / `<x> = not` cells the §66 twin generator cannot type — O35), so the pure bootstrap grades it NOT-TWINNED. This twin runs the bootstrap's OWN server artifact (s468 U1c print-server.scrml + server-runtime.js) through the counter's server-executor seam. XFAIL on impl#1: it does not parse the §66 opener (`let <x:T=v/>`, `<x:T[replace]=(v)/>`) — the opener half of the carried gap named below (the precedent: control-flow/if-chain-program-first-true-rt); impl#1's own run of the same program is pinned by the legacy case.
